main.description: Binds a social.colibri.community (identified by this record's own repo DID) to the code-forge owner(s) it provides chat for. Lives on the community DID's own repo, so no separate attestation is needed: the community's credentials are already custodied by the AppView that created it for a live-verified forge admin, and this record is that same AppView's account speaking for itself.

boundOwners.description: Forge owner(s) (users or organisations) this community serves. Ordinarily a single entry; the array leaves room for a community to later claim more than one owner without a schema change.

host.description: Host for self-hosted instances. Omit for the provider's canonical host.

owner.description: Owner (user or organisation) login on the forge.
